name: Declared Summaries in Directory Audits
description: C06 audit wiring demo: `audit --enable-summaries` runs the declared produce routes per unit of a mixed TypeScript/Go directory and records only manifest metadata in summary_audits — ts-summaries emitted in-process, go-summaries skipped without the declared helper, then go-summaries emitted once --go-types provisions it.

harness_contract.intent: Demonstrate audit --enable-summaries end to end: a directory audit spawns the declared ts-summaries route in-process, records skipped_no_helper for the Go package without --go-types, and records an emitted go-summaries manifest once the helper is provisioned.
artifact_contracts: Read inputs: scenarios/audit_summaries/src/util.ts and src/util.go plus the sibling mumei-agent audit and *-summaries routes.
Step 1 needs no toolchain: the TypeScript route runs in-process, so the run is deterministic and reports ts-summaries emitted + go-summaries skipped_no_helper.
Step 2 is SKIPPED without a maintained Go toolchain; with one it builds the go-types helper and the Go package unit records emitted.
Generate evidence: audit_summaries.log, audit_with_helper.log, audit.json, audit_helper.json, harness_state.json, result.json, and report.md.
summary_audits is advisory metadata — route, unit, status, context_key, function_count — and never flips the audit's success; manifest bytes are never stored.
notes: The produce routes are source-analysis infrastructure, not verifiers; the demo records only their declared manifest metadata.
Every run exits the pipe-and-grep form so a refused route or a failed audit cannot pass silently as exit-0 output.
Fixture mode (CI_FIXTURE_MODE=1) replays recorded route metadata for the helper-bound step so CI stays deterministic without a Go toolchain.
budget_policy_fingerprint is audit-summaries-v1 for deterministic runs.

steps.name: Audit: declared summaries without the Go helper
steps.command:
{mumei_agent_python} -m agent audit --json --enable-summaries --code-file {root_dir}/scenarios/audit_summaries/src > {output_dir}/audit.json 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/audit.json; test $rc -eq 0 && {mumei_agent_python} - <<'PY'
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path
data = json.loads(Path("{output_dir}/audit.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
entries = data.get("summary_audits") or []
ts = [e for e in entries if e.get("route") == "ts-summaries"]
go = [e for e in entries if e.get("route") == "go-summaries"]
ok = (
    len(ts) == 1 and ts[0].get("status") == "emitted"
    and len(go) == 1 and go[0].get("status") == "skipped_no_helper"
)
if not ok:
    print("summary_audits: expected ts-summaries emitted + go-summaries skipped_no_helper", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)
print("summary_audits: ts-summaries emitted, go-summaries skipped_no_helper")
PY
steps.artifact_contract: audit.json must hold a summary_audits list with one entry per unit: ts-summaries emitted for util.ts and go-summaries skipped_no_helper for the Go package directory.
steps.verifier_gate: audit exits 0 and summary_audits reports ts-summaries emitted plus go-summaries skipped_no_helper when no helper is declared.

steps.name: Audit: go-summaries emitted once --go-types is declared
steps.command:
if [ "${CI_FIXTURE_MODE:-0}" = "1" ]; then {mumei_agent_python} - <<'PY'
import json
payload = {
    "summary_audits": [
        {"route": "ts-summaries", "unit": "util.ts", "status": "emitted", "context_key": "fixture", "function_count": 2},
        {"route": "go-summaries", "unit": ".", "status": "emitted", "context_key": "fixture", "function_count": 2}
    ]
}
from pathlib import Path
Path("{output_dir}/audit_helper.json").write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
PY
else mkdir -p {output_dir}/bin && cd {mumei_agent_repo}/tools/go-types && GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off GOWORK=off go build -o {output_dir}/bin/go-types . && cd {mumei_agent_repo} && {mumei_agent_python} -m agent audit --json --enable-summaries --go-types {output_dir}/bin/go-types --code-file {root_dir}/scenarios/audit_summaries/src > {output_dir}/audit_helper.json 2>&1; fi
rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/audit_helper.json; test $rc -eq 0 && {mumei_agent_python} - <<'PY'
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path
data = json.loads(Path("{output_dir}/audit_helper.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
entries = data.get("summary_audits") or []
go = [e for e in entries if e.get("route") == "go-summaries"]
ok = (
    len(go) == 1
    and go[0].get("status") == "emitted"
    and go[0].get("function_count")
    and all(e.get("status") != "skipped_no_helper" for e in entries)
)
if not ok:
    print("summary_audits: go-summaries entry is not emitted", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)
print("summary_audits: go-summaries emitted for the package unit")
PY
steps.artifact_contract: audit_helper.json must show the Go package unit's go-summaries entry emitted with context_key and function_count once --go-types is provisioned; skipped_no_helper must be absent.
steps.verifier_gate: audit exits 0 and summary_audits reports go-summaries emitted (function_count present), never skipped_no_helper, when the helper is declared.

intro: Step 1: audit --enable-summaries runs the declared produce routes per unit of a mixed directory — ts-summaries emitted in-process, go-summaries honestly skipped without the helper...
Step 2: with the go-types helper provisioned, the same audit records go-summaries emitted for the package unit...
narrative.before: Directory audits verify files one by one but never invoke the declared summary routes; reuse metadata for sibling units is invisible.
narrative.after: audit.json records one summary_audits entry per unit — route, status, context_key, function_count — and audit_helper.json shows the Go package unit emitted once --go-types is declared.

pass.headline: summary_audits: ts emitted, go skipped_no_helper
follow_up: Each unit records only declared metadata — manifest bytes never reach the report.
skipped_no_helper is honest: no --go-types means no Go helper spawn.
Step 2: Declaring --go-types and re-running the audit...

pass.headline: go-summaries emitted for the package unit
follow_up: The Go package directory is one unit — all .go files bind one context_key.
Advisory only: the emitted status never flips the audit's own success.
Demo complete: declared summaries are observable inside real audits.
